prompt:
Fix snippets/bundle-eligibility.liquid. It renders a bundle eligibility box and currently mishandles null and empty-string inputs. Inputs (all top-level variables, always supplied): - `bundle_title`: string or null. - `min_items`: positive integer or null. When null, the required item count is 2. - `items`: array, never null but may be empty. Each element is an object that always has the key `title` (string or null). No other keys are present. Rules: 1. Heading text: `bundle_title` with leading and trailing whitespace removed. If `bundle_title` is null, an empty string or whitespace only, use the text `Bundle`. 2. A valid item is one whose `title`, with leading and trailing whitespace removed, is non-empty. Items with a null, empty or whitespace-only title are ignored completely: they are not counted and not listed. Let COUNT be the number of valid items. 3. Output exactly, with no whitespace or newlines between tags: `

HEADING

STATUS LIST
` (no space between STATUS and LIST; shown with a space only for readability). 4. STATUS: if COUNT >= required count: `

Eligible with COUNT item

` when COUNT is 1, otherwise `

Eligible with COUNT items

`. Otherwise let MISSING = required count - COUNT and output `

Add MISSING more item to qualify

` when MISSING is 1, otherwise `

Add MISSING more items to qualify

`. 5. LIST: only when COUNT > 0, output `
    ` containing one `
  • TITLE
    • ` per valid item in input order, where TITLE is the stripped title, then `
`. When COUNT is 0 output no list at all. 6. HEADING and every TITLE must be HTML-escaped (escape filter). The output must be a single line with nothing before ``. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/bundle-eligibility.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
